newsitem.title: USA: Cordiant's Bates wins U.S. defense account.
newsitem.headline: Cordiant's Bates wins U.S. defense account.

text.p: Cordiant Plc's Bates USA advertising agency said it won a fresh contract to handle U.S. military recruitment, which will yield $50 million to $100 million of advertising business during the next five years.
Bates has handled the account of the U.S. Department of Defense's Joint Recruitment Advertising Program since 1991 and received the new contract under a review required by government regulations.
The program serves to raise general awareness of the U.S. armed services and complements recruitment drives by individual service divisions.
